# Meshy 3D Generation

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a workflow that turns your Muse into a 3D asset studio: describe a model in plain words (or hand over a photo) and it drives the Meshy CLI through generation, texturing, rigging, and animation, delivering ready-to-use files after showing you a preview. By @meshy-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: cloud generations consume Meshy credits beyond the free quota, so always ask for the cost estimate before a run; login uses a device code you approve yourself in your browser — never paste credentials in chat; a rendered preview does not prove clean topology or print quality, inspect the result yourself.
